about: GENERATED by tools/gen_memory.py from the allocation routines and state types in src/ and config/memory.json - do not edit

measured.status: measured on the test card (compute capability 12.0, Linux, nvfortran 25.3)
measured.machine: the Linux test machine with the test card
measured.profile: the card build with every physics stage on the card
measured.held_q_why: 206 MiB: context, runtime and module image at the first runtime allocation; the card's free memory at the check (Q) already excludes it, so the program does not add it, and ./lean doctor, which runs before any program, does
measured.stack_why: charged at the first launch of a kernel that needs it: stack = threads x (frame - 1,024 B), the default 1 KiB being inside held_q; threads = SMs x the most resident threads per SM, both read from the card
measured.card_round_why: each card allocation of 2 MiB or more takes whole 2 MiB pages: applied per array of a card row
measured.residual_why: 32 MiB: the largest remainder of six measured runs (16 to 32 MiB): peak use minus held_q, the card rows and the stack, after the 2 MiB rounding
